messages.subject: No Renjin found
parts:
Hello,

I have renjin-script-engine-0.7.0-RC7-SNAPSHOT-jar-with-dependencies.jar in my path directory and everything works fine.  Now if I add the latest version of Renjin 
renjin-studio-0.7.1579-jar-with-dependencies.jar, I get that the Renjin script engine is not available when doing 

@engine = factory.getEngineByName("Renjin")

Any help?

Thanks


--
Rodrigo Botafogo

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: No Renjin found
parts:
renjin-studio does not include RenjinScriptEngine. Include renjin-script-engine-0.7.1579-jar-with-dependencies.jar and it should work.

Alex
